name: io.github.kimi94279-glitch/openstem-mcp
title: OpenSTEM
description: STEM study tools: LaTeX/circuit figures, math and unit checks, PDF/HWP reading, exam/slide export

environmentVariables.name: OPENSTEM_LMS_SCHOOL
environmentVariables.description: Korean university name for the read-only lms tool, e.g. 성균관대

environmentVariables.name: OPENSTEM_LMS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Access token the student created in their LMS

environmentVariables.name: OPENSTEM_LMS_CALENDAR_URL
environmentVariables.description: LMS calendar feed URL (deadlines only, when no token)
